facts.fact: Corrects F895/F1031/F1032 (flag for S7): the queen keeps Neela in the drying shed (not the sea room) from before the noon gun until after the water-clock bell turns, so the queen misses her noon audience. Neela recognises the noon gun as the gun and deliberately keeps her hand still rather than prick in front of the queen, so as not to show where the lever bites. She pricks three times only after the queen leaves, an hour late.

Revises F870: Neela half-forms the question about Chathu's grey-stained fingertips and the unanswered steward's list, and chooses not to voice it, because asking would tell the queen what she is checking. The clue stays live by her choice.
Aligns with F683: Devan's garrison saluted him fist by fist as he walked out of the hall, not at the gate.
